usageNotes: Use this to enumerate all PDM user accounts — any authenticated user can call it, but non-admin callers only receive their own record. Pass include_tokens=true when auditing API token usage or preparing to rotate tokens. The response includes account enable/disable state and expiration timestamps, making it useful for periodic access reviews.

examples.summary: List all users including their API tokens

tips: Non-privileged callers silently receive only their own user object — check the caller's realm privileges if the list looks unexpectedly short.
Token objects in the response never include the raw secret; use this to audit token IDs and expiry, not to retrieve secrets.
A non-zero 'tfa-locked-until' timestamp means the user is blocked from MFA-protected operations until that epoch; admin intervention is required to unlock early.
Expired users (expire > 0 and past current time) remain in the list — filter by 'enable' and 'expire' client-side if you need only active accounts.
